fato_historico: 1959: Quake Lake is formed by the magnitude 7.2 1959 Hebgen Lake earthquake near Hebgen Lake in Montana.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a shift in the landscape of your soul, much like the sudden arrival of a new lake after a powerful mountain tremor. You are invited to process these deep changes with grace. It is a good time to let your emotions settle into a serene basin, allowing clarity to emerge from recent intensity.
frase_do_dia: Even the earth shifts to create beauty where there was none before.
significado_numero: A number representing spiritual awakening and the pursuit of your true path.
conselho: Consider grounding your wandering thoughts by spending time near a body of water.
